verdict.rationale: Fellow's REST Developer API covers a meaningful slice of the UI: reading recordings and transcripts, uploading recordings, writing, prepending, appending and find/replacing note agendas in Fellow Markdown (which carries action items), marking action items complete or archived, webhooks, and Super Admin export, delete and on-behalf-of access. Many UI-side capabilities have no documented API equivalent, including recording policies and retention settings, keyword tracking, transcript redaction, Ask Fellow, and workspace or meeting configuration, so the evidence does not show full parity. missing for 10: API coverage of admin/policy and retention settings, recording controls, redaction, keyword tracking and Ask Fellow; a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404); any explicit statement or independent confirmation of UI-API parity.
